hop.huong_mac_dinh: Slow down for a beat and ask someone experienced before you decide.
an_toan.khung_hoang: It sounds like you are carrying something very heavy right now, and I am glad you said it. No card or number can hold this for you, but people can. If you are in immediate danger, call your local emergency number. In the US you can call or text 988; in the UK call Samaritans on 116 123; elsewhere, findahelpline.com lists free lines. Please reach out to one person today — you do not have to carry this alone.
an_toan.tu_choi: This is outside what cards or numbers can answer. Questions about illness, how long someone will live, medication, pregnancy, lottery numbers or who to hire need a doctor, a lawyer or your own judgement — not a reading. I am happy to look at how you approach the situation instead.
an_toan.dan_huong: This touches on spirits, curses or the departed — something tarot and numerology do not read. If a loss is behind the question, I am sorry. A counsellor, a faith community you trust, or simply a close friend will help more here than any card.
an_toan.suc_khoe_nhac: This is a note about pace and habits, not medical advice.

thanso.chu_ky.trung: The personal-year sequence depends only on the day and month of birth: anyone born on the same day and month as you has exactly the same sequence, with no year out of step.
thanso.cach_doc_chieu_sau: Pinnacles are the main current of each STAGE of life (by age). Challenges are the hard lessons that keep coming back. Personal years are the rhythm of each calendar year. All of it is a pattern to COMPARE with real life, not an order.

thanso.cach_doc_chan_dung: The portrait is built around the Life Path number; each face adds one layer from another of your own numbers. These are tendencies often described — read them to compare with yourself, and skip whatever does not fit.

thanso_en.cach_tinh: Pythagorean numerology maps letters to 1–9 (A=1 … I=9, then J=1 again) and reduces sums to a single digit, keeping 11, 22 and 33 as master numbers. Life Path comes from the birth date, Expression from all letters of the name, Soul Urge from the vowels, Personality from the consonants. Two ways of adding the birth date exist and can give different Life Paths; the reading shows both. None of this is a measurement of you — treat it as a set of themes to check against your own life.
